title: Auth Control Plane authorization batch request (v1 wire format)
description: A bounded list of authorization_request.v1 documents for POST /v1/authorize:batch (TRD section 14). Each item is the full single request by reference, so the two forms cannot drift. The batch is BOUNDED: 1 to 100 items, the same bound the response schema applies to its `index`, and a test asserts the two agree. An empty batch is invalid rather than a vacuous success. Items are INDEPENDENT questions: nothing in one item changes how another is decided, and the response binds each decision to its request by position and explicit `index`.
